edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the sender address to the core transfer routine.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
Entire ETH balance is pushed to msg.sender through an unchecked low-level call.
Constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
getTime directly returns block.timestamp.
Router swap deadline is set to block.timestamp.
Router liquidity deadline is set to block.timestamp.
OwnerForcedSwapBack event emits block.timestamp.
Transfer delay check relies on tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
tx.origin is used as the key and value of the anti-bot timestamp mapping.
_transfer forwards sender, recipient and amount into _tokenTransfer.
_transfer conditionally invokes swapBack when thresholds are met.
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to decide whether to trigger a swap.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy versus sell fee paths.
maxTransactionAmount is enforced on buys and sells.
gasPriceLimit is enforced against tx.gasprice on AMM buys.
_tokenTransfer variants obtain amounts from _getValues.
Liquidity portion of the transfer is routed to _takeLiquidity.
swapBack swaps accumulated tokens for ETH.
swapBack adds the liquidity portion back to the pool.
swapBack transfers remaining ETH to marketing using an unchecked low-level call.
marketingAddress is the call target receiving the ETH balance.
_liquidityTokensToSwap is consumed and reset during swapBack.
_marketingTokensToSwap is consumed and reset during swapBack.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwapAndLiquify around the swap logic.
swapTokensForETH performs an external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs a payable external router call.
withdrawStuckETH forwards the whole balance through a low-level call.
transferForeignToken calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20.
launch adds initial ETH liquidity via the router.
launch activates trading as its final step.
launch rewrites liquidityAddress before and after liquidity add.
launch moves the owner remainder into the contract through _tokenTransfer.
launch registers the created pair as an AMM pair.
launch stores the newly created Uniswap pair address.
launch stores the Uniswap router address.
forceSwapBack invokes swapBack directly.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases the allowance mapping.

setMarketingAddress updates the payable marketing wallet.
setLiquidityAddress updates the payable liquidity wallet.

enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading records block.number as tradingActiveBlock.
excludeFromMaxTransaction exempts accounts from the max amount limit.

Enabling a pair excludes it from reflections.
Disabling a pair re-includes it in reflections.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair validates then calls the internal setter.
excludeFromReward reads _rOwned to snapshot the token balance.
excludeFromReward writes the excluded account token balance.
includeInReward clears _tOwned for the re-included account.
Buy fee parameters drive the fee values used inside _transfer.
Sell fee parameters drive the fee values used inside _transfer.
removeLimits disables limitsInEffect.

removeLimits disables the transfer delay.
approve writes the allowance mapping via _approve.
